title: Field
behavior: Field invalid controls visual error styling; set aria-invalid on the input separately.
FieldLabel required is a visual mark; set required on the input.
FieldError has role=alert; its id must be associated with the input.
FieldSet and FieldLegend group related controls semantically.

For browser automation, locate the textbox by role and accessible name, then verify its native label association. The aria-hidden required mark may appear in exact label-text queries; do not put it in the accessible name.
verification: Pilot composition and typed examples; not exhaustive coverage of every prop combination.
